arguments.rationale: Two complete executions now differ in exactly one controller weight (holding_tip_speed_weight 0.0 -> 0.05). Reported separately per physical dimension: (reach) baseline terminal_error_m 0.007642608585867386 m vs candidate 0.00869890424761182 m, delta +0.001056295661744434 m; terminal reach passed in both, candidate slightly worse. (holding position) baseline holding-window max error 0.05813810428573256 m vs candidate 0.05650455971948983 m, delta -0.001633544566242727 m; both above the 0.01 m limit, holding_position_passed false in both. (holding speed) baseline max speed 1.5810152739742807 m/s vs candidate 1.1750052670100422 m/s, delta -0.4060100069642385 m/s; both far above the 0.02 m/s limit, holding_speed_passed false in both. (computation) baseline mean update 17.26331904856488 s vs candidate 17.714294602841672 s, delta +0.45097555427679126 s; deadline_misses 35 and solver_error_count 0 in both. The sealed classification is physical_tradeoff; ranking is componentwise physical comparison with joint acceptance first, and raw objective scalars under different weights are not ranked. Accordingly the zero-tip-speed-weight hypothesis is weakened (the changed weight moved holding speed in the expected direction but did not resolve the failure and coincided with slightly worse reach/computation), reach-tolerance-violation stays rejected, the budget-truncation coincidence stays retained/untested, the reach-passed/holding-failed descriptive pattern is retained, and no dominant cause is established. Diagnostic recommendation acceptance is handled separately from selecting a controller candidate, and no causal inference is drawn from citation validity.
arguments.recommendation: Accept the diagnostic recommendation separately from candidate selection: do NOT advance improvement-744833804049 as the controller candidate. The sealed candidate-vs-baseline comparison is a physical_tradeoff - reach stays passed but slightly worse (+0.001056295661744434 m terminal error), holding position (0.05650455971948983 m vs 0.01 m) and holding speed (1.1750052670100422 m/s vs 0.02 m/s) improve only marginally and still fail, and computation is slightly slower (+0.45097555427679126 s mean update) with 35/35 deadline misses in both - so joint_reach_holding_passed remains false. Retain both prior parameters as deferred. If further improvement work is authorized, keep exactly one changed positive weight per experiment with unchanged reach/holding evaluation; no controller candidate may be selected until joint reach-and-holding acceptance is met.
